title: Tagging a Gene of Interest with AID
author: Kizhakke Mattada Sathyan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdyei7te
materials: Digest 3 µg of pX458 with BbsI Overnight at 37 °C The overnight digestion with BbsI significantly reduces negative colonies. BbsI reaction mix: NEB buffer 2.1 5.0 µl BbsI enzyme 1.0 µl 100X BSA 0.5 µl pX458 plasmid 3.0 µg Water to 50 µl

Use a transilluminator to excise the digested band using a clean scalpel and use the QIAquick gel extraction kit (Qiagen, 28704) to isolate the digested plasmid. The use of the blue light dark reader transilluminator (Clare Chemical Research, USA) may reduce DNA damage during gel excision. The digested plasmid runs between supercoiled and relaxed DNA in the undigested control sample.

The method described here is adapted from the kit manual with minor changes (QIAquick gel extraction kit, Qiagen, 28704). Add three volumes of buffer QG to one volume of gel; consider 1 mg of gel equivalent to 1 µL . For example, add 300 µL of QG buffer for 100 mg of gel.

Phosphorylate and anneal the forward and reverse oligonucleotides of the sgRNA guide sequence in one reaction. Phosphorylation and annealing reaction mix: Forward (100 µM) 1 µl Reverse (100 µM) 1 µl T4 DNA Ligase buffer 1 µl T4 PNK 1 µl Water 6 µl Incubate in a thermocycler 37 °C 00:30:00 95 °C 00:05:00 Ramp down to 4 °C at 4 °C /min rate.
Combine all the gel slices into one tube and purify the DNA using the Qiagen gel purification kit similar to steps 2 – 12.

Electrophorese whole PCR product on 1 % agarose gel, excise the band using a clean scalpel and use the Qiagen gel purification kit to isolate genomic DNA (follow steps 2 – 12). Sequence the purified PCR product with the forward primer to confirm the reading frame. Successful integration of the AID-P2A-HygR or HygR-P2A-AID results in an addition of approximately 1785 bp to the PCR product. Heterozygous clones will have two bands, one with a length of genomic region between forward and reverse primer and the second with a length of genomic region between primers plus the 1785 bp. The homozygous integration will result in one band with a length of genomic region between primers plus the 1785 bp. Sequence the integrated DNA using the same forward primer, which will confirm successful integration.

steps.title: Gel Electrophoresis and DNA Recovery
steps.instruction: Analyze the DNA mixture via agarose gel electrophoresis and recover the desired fragment.

substeps.instruction: Add 8 µL loading dye to the mixture and load onto a 1% agarose gel, using undigested pX458 vector as a negative control.
Incubate the gel at 50 °C for 10 minutes, vortexing every 3 minutes to dissolve the gel.
Once dissolved, add 10 µL of 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5) and briefly vortex.
Add one gel-volume of isopropanol and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Purify DNA using QIAquick Column
steps.instruction: Purify the recovered DNA using a QIAquick column and centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the mixture into a QIAquick column and centrifuge at 17,000 x g for 1 minute. Repeat if dissolved gel mixture remains.
Discard flow-through, place column back in the collection tube, add 500 µL QG buffer, and centrifuge at 17,000 x g for 1 minute.
Discard flow-through, place column back in the collection tube, add 750 µL PE buffer, and centrifuge at 17,000 x g for 1 minute.
Discard flow-through, replace column in the tube, and centrifuge again at 17,000 x g for 2 minutes.
Place column in a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube, add 50 µL DNase and RNase free water, incubate for 2 minutes, and centrifuge at 9,000 x g for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Quantify and Store DNA
steps.instruction: Quantify the purified DNA using a NanoDrop and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare sgRNA Guide Sequence
steps.instruction: Prepare and dilute the sgRNA guide sequence for ligation.

substeps.instruction: Create a 100 µM solution of the forward and reverse strands of the sgRNA guide sequence in nuclease-free water.
Dilute the annealed sgRNA guide sequence pair 20x by adding 190 µL of nuclease-free water to reach a final concentration of 500 nM.

steps.title: Ligate sgRNA into pX458 Vector
steps.instruction: Perform ligation of the sgRNA into the BbsI digested pX458 vector.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the ligation mix: 50 ng BbsI digested pX458, 1 µL annealed sgRNA (500 nM), 1 µL T4 ligase Buffer, 1 µL T4 DNA Ligase, and water to a total volume of 10 µL.
Incubate the mix for 2 hours at room temperature or overnight at 16 °C. Include a no-insert control.

steps.title: Transform E. coli
steps.instruction: Transform the ligated product into chemically competent E. coli cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL of the ligated product to 20 µL chemically competent E. coli (e.g., Max efficiency DH5a).
Incubate on ice for 30 minutes, then heat shock at 42 °C for 30 seconds.
Add 250 µL LB or SOC media and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour.
Plate 272 µL of cells on a carbenicillin plate and incubate at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Screen and Recover Plasmid
steps.instruction: Inoculate colonies and extract the plasmid DNA.

substeps.instruction: Pick three colonies per plate and inoculate in LB containing carbenicillin; incubate overnight at 37 °C.
Pellet the culture by centrifugation at 17,000 x g for 1 minute.
Perform DNA extraction using the QIAprep spin miniprep kit and elute DNA in 50 µL nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Verify sgRNA Insertion
steps.instruction: Confirm the sgRNA insertion via sequencing using the LKO.1 5' primer or the U6 promoter primer.

steps.title: Transfect HEK293T Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect HEK293T cells with the sgRNA plasmid.

substeps.instruction: Plate 30% confluent HEK293T cells in a 6-well plate (starting with 2 x 10^5 cells).
Transfect 1 µg of sgRNA plasmid using Lipofectamine 3000 reagents.
Replace media with 2 mL new media 24 hours after transfection. Assess efficiency via GFP fluorescence under a microscope.

steps.title: Collect Cells for Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Harvest cells 72 hours post-transfection for DNA isolation.

substeps.instruction: 72 hours after transfection, remove 1 mL of media and collect cells in the remaining 1 mL by pipetting.
Transfer to a 1.5 ml tube and centrifuge at 6,000 x g for 2 minutes; remove media.
Proceed with genomic DNA isolation.

steps.title: Amplify Target Region by PCR
steps.instruction: Perform PCR to amplify the region targeted by the sgRNA.

substeps.instruction: Design primers ~250 bp upstream and downstream of the cut site (amplicon size 500bp to 1Kb).

Prepare PCR mix: 5.0 µL genomic DNA (10 ng/µl), 1.0 µL Forward primer, 1.0 µL Reverse primer, 2.5 µL 10X HF buffer, 0.5 µL DMSO (100%), 1.0 µL 10 mM DNTP, 1.0 µL MgSO4, 0.5 µL Platinum Taq DNA Polymerase High Fidelity, and 12.5 µL water.
Run PCR: Initial denaturation 95 °C (5 min); 30 cycles of 95 °C (30 sec), annealing temp (30 sec), 68 °C (1 min); Final extension 68 °C (10 min); 4 °C hold.
Verify amplification by running 5 µL of product (mixed with 2 µL 6x DNA sample buffer) on a 1% agarose gel at 90V.

steps.title: Perform Surveyor Assay
steps.instruction: Analyze sgRNA efficiency using the Surveyor nuclease assay.

substeps.instruction: Denature PCR products at 95 °C for 10 minutes, then renature stepwise: 85, 75, 65, 55, 45, 35, 25 °C (1 min each) with a ramp down of 0.3 °C/sec, then 4 °C hold.
Prepare reaction mix: 20.0 µL reannealed PCR product, 1.0 µL Surveyor Nuclease S, 1.0 µL Surveyor Enhancer S, and 2.0 µL 0.15 M MgCl2.
Incubate at 42 °C for 1 hour in a thermocycler.
Stop reaction with 2.4 µL Stop Solution. Run on a 2% agarose gel at 90V and visualize via UV transilluminator.

steps.title: Prepare HDR Template
steps.instruction: Amplify and purify the homology repair (HDR) template.

substeps.instruction: Synthesize primers from IDT with phosphorothioate modifications.

Amplify HDR template (4-8 reactions of 50 µL each) using: 50.0 ng Plasmid DNA, 1.0 µL 10 µM Primer F, 1.0 µL 10 µM Primer R, 5.0 µL 10X High Fidelity buffer, 0.5 µL DMSO, 2.0 µL 10 mM DNTP, 2.0 µL MgSO4, 0.5 µL Platinum Taq DNA Polymerase High Fidelity, and water to 50 µL.
Run PCR: 95 °C (5 min); 30 cycles of 95 °C (30 sec), 60 °C (30 sec), 68 °C (1 min); Final extension 68 °C (10 min); 4 °C hold.
Gel purify the PCR products to remove long primers.
Elute DNA in 50-100 µL nuclease-free water, quantify via NanoDrop, and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Cotransfect Cells for Tagging
steps.instruction: Cotransfect ARF-AID progenitor cells with sgRNA and HDR template.

substeps.instruction: Grow ARF-AID progenitor cells and split into 6-well plates to ~30% confluency.
Cotransfect 1 µg gene-specific sgRNA plasmid and 400 ng dsHDR template using 5-7.5 µL Lipofectamine reagent.
Include parental pX458 + HDR product as a transfection control and an untransfected control well.
Replace media with new media 24 hours after transfection.

steps.title: Select and Expand Clones
steps.instruction: Expand cells and select for tagged clones using hygromycin B.

substeps.instruction: 48 hours after transfection, expand each well into a 10 cm plate.
72 hours after transfection, add hygromycin B to a final concentration of 100 µg/ml. If cell number is low, delay selection until day 5.
Use conditioned media (8:2 ratio of new to filtered cultured media) to increase survival.
Once all cells in the control plate are dead, replace media with regular conditioned media.
Wait 2-3 weeks for colonies to appear.

steps.title: Screen for Tagged Clones
steps.instruction: Identify successfully tagged clones via Western blot and sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Pick colonies and screen via Western blotting using gene-specific antibodies (look for a 24 kDa size increase).
Confirm integration and reading frame of AIDP2A-HygR or HygR-P2A-AID via PCR and sequencing.
Perform genomic DNA PCR on selected colonies using the sgRNA efficiency primers, increasing the extension time to 4 minutes to amplify the insert.
